description:
Compare two to six Fortitude21 products on the attributes they publish.
Use when: the user is choosing between products already found with search_products. Instead: get_product_details for one product in full.
Inputs: skus may mix part numbers and slugs; products come back in the order given.
Returns: products; comparable, the rows every product has a value for; partial, the rows some lack, naming them, so a blank is never read as a worse figure; and note, how to read the comparison.
Behaviour: read-only. It does not rank or recommend: which product suits depends on the contents, the destination market and the order. Fewer than two skus, more than six, or an unknown one returns ok:false naming the problem.
Constraints: no authentication, key or headers. At most 10 requests per 10 seconds per IP address; above that HTTP 429, so space out repeated calls.

skus.description: Two to six F21 part numbers or product slugs, from search_products

name: compare_products

assumed.description: Each value the tool inferred or defaulted, in words, so it can be checked with the user

cite.description: Credit line with a link, for quoting the answer

comparable.description: Attribute rows where every product has a value

error.description: When ok is false: what is missing or could not be read, and what to send instead

ok.description: true with an answer. false when the tool needs one more input or cannot answer; error then says what to send

partial.description: Attribute rows where some products have no recorded value, naming them

products.description: The products compared, with sku, name and url

publisher.description: Who publishes the tool, the Fortitude21 products that fit, with links, and quote_url, a link to ask for a quotation

tool.description: Link to the same answer on the interactive tool page

title: Compare Fortitude21 products
